parsing_traps: Portfolio Statement uses a FACING-PAGE POSITIONAL SPLIT: property-name/tenure/location table on pages 116/118/120, and the value table (gross revenue / occupancy / valuation, blank first column) on the facing pages 117/119/121. Rows are aligned by position only. Routed properties to llm_only (positional pairing read directly from the markdown). Verified row-by-row against the audited sub-totals.

Statement of Profit or Loss prints both Group and MPACT (trust-only) columns side by side. Canonical = Group (consolidated) column. MPACT-only column (e.g. gross revenue 456,772; includes S$814.2m impairment of investment in subsidiary) is NOT used.
income_taxes is a tax CREDIT of S$6,113k in FY24/25 (negative expense): stored SIGNED negative in income_stmt_metrics; in line_items the adjustment is +6,113k (credit increases total return).
